host_scope: Observed shared research host; no deployment SLA or dedicated-machine latency claim

confirmation_internal.scope: Internal execution, overlaps whole-child cost; do not add to whole-child totals

confirmation_whole_child.scope: Whole Python child including imports and waited codec children; RSS is peak, not summed process RSS

independent_audit.scope: Separate read-only audit; exec-tool wall and internal audit clocks; no CPU/RSS measurement claimed

primary_analysis_whole_child.scope: One whole analysis subprocess; no model or ASR rerun

training_record.scope: Recorded training main, including source preparation and six arms; imports before main excluded
